editor.asset_save_target.reason: Legacy SaveTarget/PublishedAsset roles deleted; exact physical target/version, baseline adoption and Save As observed via original coordinator and installed roles.

editor.context_lifecycle.reason: Replace removed Context/PaneManager owner with real application construction/destruction, task observer, complete detached factories, retained sessions and Host lifetime.

editor.unified_core_factory-rollback.reason: Factory rejection never publishes partial content; view failure preserves published content; C04 actual required menu failure rejects application create.

editor.unified_core_fixed-run.reason: Frozen Run uses original runtime, separate identity/history, pause/step/stop and source isolation; source draft changes cannot rewrite capture.

editor.unified_core_flow-gui.reason: Real Flow graph UI interactions retain original source stamps, History, undo/redo and graph layout; formal application composes fields and compilation.

editor.unified_core_material-gui.reason: Real material UI uses typed draft/commit against author graph; compiler/preview ownership separate; source/history/layout survive save and UI closure.

editor.unified_core_new-assets.reason: Formal creation commands produce unbound typed sessions and shared views, Scene form creates actual description; untitled save uses prepared Save As.

editor.unified_core_save-partial.reason: Multi-content close collects permits, keeps all UI/content on B cancellation, retains A physical publication; no premature view deletion.

editor.unified_core_save-preservation.reason: Same source/package identities, unknown payload, author state/history and source/pak/catalog outcomes observed through formal save roles.

editor.unified_core_save-retry.reason: Accurate conflict/Unknown and retry through same coordinator; rejected adoption leaves baseline while terminal file facts persist.

editor.unified_exit-review.reason: Atomic close decisions and real modal Cancel/Keep/Close, live Run, accepted encoder/compiler and GPU drain; same-content views de-duplicate work.

policy: Names identify observations, not a numeric substitute for original assertions. Old product implementations are not rebuilt.
